subject: The wardroom of the colony ship ariadne at supper, one table and one pot. The real coffee ran out in month nine. Roberta has dug one more tin out from behind a coolant manifold in the lander bay, and it's on the table between Roberta and Lou, and Roberta hasn't let go of it. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
card: soc.coffee, version halloran+brandt (js/content-social-alt.js; tests and effects in js/content-social.js)
notes: A crew photo for one pairing of this card's two leads. The incident is NOT the plain soc scene with faces swapped: this version of the card was rewritten for these two people (title: The Last Tin). Read the version's text for what must be visible. Quiet, small stakes, nothing has gone wrong yet.
